rules.rationale: Heteroatom-rich molecules carry polar functionality that lowers octanol-water partitioning, the lipophilicity measure.
Halogen-free molecules lack apolar substituents, so their polar surface dominates partitioning into octanol.
Aromatic pi systems are apolar and raise octanol-water partition coefficients, the direct lipophilicity measure.
High branching adds polar substituents and raises molecular volume, both lowering octanol solubility.

skills.hypothesis: Lipophilicity tracks polar surface area: heteroatom-rich, halogen-free, unbranched scaffolds score lowest, while aromatic pi systems raise octanol partitioning. Fails if the pool's polarity range is narrow or if halogenation dominates the measured partitioning.

rules.rationale: Halogenation adds apolar substituents that favor octanol partitioning, the direct lipophilicity measure.
Counter-hypothesis: heteroatom-rich scaffolds carry apolar heterocycles that raise octanol-water partitioning.
Aromatic pi systems are apolar and raise octanol-water partition coefficients, the direct lipophilicity measure.
Rigid ring systems raise molecular volume and hydrogen bonding capacity, both lowering octanol solubility.

skills.hypothesis: Lipophilicity tracks apolar partitioning: halogenated, heteroatom-rich, aromatic scaffolds score highest, while high ring content raises polar surface. Fails if the pool's polarity range is wide or if ring topology dominates the measured partitioning.

lesson: Across four development seeds, the polarity-surface-area skill (mean AUC 88.27, mean final best 88.81) slightly trailed the apolar-partitioning counter-hypothesis skill (mean AUC 89.49, mean final best 93.75). Seed-level variation was large, so no causal inference about mechanism is possible.
revision_summary: Kept the deployed polarity-surface-area skill unchanged and retained the apolar-partitioning counter-hypothesis skill. The polarity skill deployed again because octanol-water partitioning is the direct lipophilicity measure, and polarity is the dominant driver of partitioning, even though the counter-hypothesis skill led on one seed.
